csv_row.author: Semprini
csv_row.description: Use this skill when the user mentions a named industry standard (BIAN, ISO 20022, FHIR, ACORD, TM Forum, etc.), when modelling a recognised industry domain (banking, payments, insurance, healthcare, telecoms, retail), or when populating the Reference column of any MD-DDL summary table. Also use when the user asks whether a concept already exists in a standard, or when two modelled concepts might map to the same standard object.
csv_row.name: standards-alignment
